I told Marcus in a thread on their message in #north-team that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal date is 25 November.

That comes from Ilse's 14 October post in #north-team. Marcus is a member of that channel, so they could see it themselves, and a renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to share. No messages in the channel since then change the date, and the GBrain search I ran on 14 October didn't turn up a conflicting date either.
